title: At Last... Google's AI Assistant Speaks Arabic! 🇱🇾
body: At Last... Google's AI Assistant Speaks Arabic! 🇱🇾
Google has announced that its AI assistant now supports Arabic and understands different Arabic dialects, reaching 15 Arab countries — including Libya, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Morocco.
After dialects held back its development, the assistant can now tell apart words that look alike in writing.
Have you tried talking to it in your dialect? 🗣️
